work_completed: After nlt-pi#33 deployed, the owner's screenshot showed the failure reasons: Vercel AI Gateway 403 for reflection/beam-free ('Free tier users do not have access to this model', type no_providers_available) and stealth/glyph-cluster ('requires an active Pro plan with purchased AI Gateway credits'). A turn with nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free completed in the sandbox. First real end-to-end turn: gate, model, sandbox, OIDC token and streaming all worked.
Checked the live public catalog: the three models have identical relevant fields (zero input/output price, tool-use tag); nothing marks free-tier access, so it cannot be detected from the catalog.

Added an owner-set allow-list NLT_AGENT_MODELS (comma-separated ids). free-models.ts: SelectOptions.allowed narrows selectFreeModels (never adds; priced or tool-less ids stay excluded), parseAllowedModels parses the value (blank means unset), pickFreeModel names the variable when nothing is left. models-route.ts and the runner's default picker (AgentRunnerDeps.allowedModels, set in api/agent.ts) use it. README documents it.

Tests: allow-list narrowing, priced/tool-less ids still excluded, blank/unset is no restriction, parsing, pickFreeModel refuses a request outside the list, /api/models lists only allowed free models, runner default picker honours it. Mutation check: dropping the runner wiring fails the runner test.
